name: GrowthBook
description: Thin MCP server for GrowthBook — skill loader + authenticated API passthrough
long_description: A thin GrowthBook MCP server with three tools: list_skills and read_skill (bundled GrowthBook agent skills) plus call_api (authenticated REST passthrough). Skills can be disabled so clients can use only the API capability with their own workflows.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List available GrowthBook agent skills (name + description).

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Return the full markdown content of a GrowthBook skill by name.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Make an authenticated HTTP request to the GrowthBook REST API. Confirm mutating methods with the user unless already instructed.

GB_API_KEY.title: GrowthBook API key or PAT
GB_API_KEY.description: A GrowthBook API key or personal access token.

GB_SKILLS_ENABLED.title: Enable bundled skills
GB_SKILLS_ENABLED.description: Set to false to disable list_skills/read_skill and use only call_api (capability-only mode).

GB_HTTP_HEADER_*.title: Custom HTTP headers
GB_HTTP_HEADER_*.description: Custom HTTP headers via GB_HTTP_HEADER_<NAME> (e.g. GB_HTTP_HEADER_CF_ACCESS_TOKEN).
